name: msi-fan-rules
purpose: Model/firmware rules + byte semantics for the MSI Claw fan path, with an explicit evidence grade per fact. Nothing here is a write strategy: block/byte semantics that were only inferred stay 'unknown'.

evidenceGrades.source-code: read from a real source file on disk (path + line recorded)
evidenceGrades.decompiled-strings: string/wide-char material extracted from a binary or helper dump (CT reference)
evidenceGrades.device-measured: measured on a real MSI device (none available in this batch)
evidenceGrades.unverified: no evidence beyond a plausible inference

Get_Fan.note: 32-byte package read; block index in byte 0

Set_Fan.note: write path - NOT used by ymcc_sim

Set_Data.note: write path - NOT used by ymcc_sim

transport.readOnlyGuarantee: the adapter only ever calls Get_*; a static assertion in msi_domain.ps1 fails if any Set_* call site, a file/EC write token, or a write cmdlet appears in its read path

blocks.caution: unit/scale/freshness unverified - never presented as RPM

blocks.source: ClawA1M.cs:1130+, Close() uses it at L448
blocks.uiGate: HC consumer only calls it for LegionGo / ClawA2VM (QuickDevicePageViewModel.cs:205-208) - dead switch for the other MSI models

bytes1_6.never: RPM (a curve byte is a duty, never a measured speed)

byte7.source: HC hardcodes the 8th table byte to 75 (ClawA1M.cs:379); CT preserves payload[7]
byte7.note: unknown whether the firmware needs it unchanged; the adapter reports it and never writes

bytes8_31.note: preserved in raw form only; never decoded into a value

bytes.note: raw only; any numeric presentation stays Unknown until a device window (B2)

unsupportedSemantics.device-not-whitelisted: model is not on deviceWhitelist -> refuse before decode; unknown stays Unknown / MSI_DEVICE_PENDING
unsupportedSemantics.block-unsupported: block index is not 1 (CPU) or 2 (GPU) -> no curve table; refuse rather than guess a value
unsupportedSemantics.scale-unverified: telemetry payload unit/scale/freshness unproven -> raw bytes only, values stay null (never 0, never RPM)
unsupportedSemantics.note: the three reasons are disjoint so 'device not whitelisted / block unsupported / telemetry unknown' never collapse into one another

rpmPolicy.rule: curve bytes must never be displayed as RPM; unknown values are null/Unknown, never 0
rpmPolicy.reason: HC ReadFanDuty returns 0 as a placeholder (IDevice.cs:1021-1028) and has zero callers - 0 is not a measurement

writePolicy.batchDecision: no EC write, no full-speed entry, no driver replacement, no global curve re-ordering in this batch
